import { z } from 'zod';
import { H, Metrics, MetricRef, Route, Router } from 'harness-dsl';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { jsonl } from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { zendesk, ZendeskEvent } from 'harness-dsl/zendesk';

const conversationSchema = z.object({
  ticketId: z.string(),
  subject: z.string(),
  message: z.string(),
  customerEmail: z.string(),
  slaDueAt: z.string(),
});
type ConversationAttrs = z.infer<typeof conversationSchema>;

const escalationSchema = z.object({
  ticketId: z.string(),
  subject: z.string(),
  reason: z.string(),
});

const New = H.state('New', 'pending');
const Classifying = H.state('Classifying', 'active');
const Drafting = H.state('Drafting', 'active');
const AwaitingApproval = H.state('AwaitingApproval', 'active');
const Sent = H.terminal('Sent', 'success');
const ClosedByCustomer = H.terminal('ClosedByCustomer', 'neutral');
const Escalated = H.terminal('Escalated', 'failure');
const SlaBreached = H.terminal('SlaBreached', 'failure');

const Open = H.state('Open', 'pending');
const Handling = H.state('Handling', 'active');
const Resolved = H.terminal('Resolved', 'success');

const Conversation = H.kind('Conversation')
  .attributes(conversationSchema)
  .states(New, Classifying, Drafting, AwaitingApproval, Sent, ClosedByCustomer, Escalated, SlaBreached)
  .key(attrs => attrs.ticketId)
  .initial(New);

const Escalation = H.kind('Escalation')
  .attributes(escalationSchema)
  .states(Open, Handling, Resolved)
  .key(attrs => attrs.ticketId)
  .initial(Open);

const customerReplied = H.signal('customer-replied').payload(z.object({ message: z.string() }));
const customerClosed = H.signal('customer-closed');
const slaBreached = H.signal('sla-breached');

const apiAccount = anthropic.account('anthropic-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') });
const apiPool = H.pool('api').accounts(apiAccount);
const haiku = anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });

const classifierRole = H.role('classifier')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Classify the customer conversation into one support category.');

const drafterRole = H.role('drafter')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Draft a reply to the customer in the house tone.');

const classifier = H.agent('classifier')
  .role(classifierRole)
  .model(haiku)
  .pool(apiPool)
  .output(z.object({ category: z.string(), summary: z.string() }));

const drafter = H.agent('drafter')
  .role(drafterRole)
  .model(sonnet)
  .pool(apiPool)
  .output(z.object({ reply: z.string() }));

const sendReply = H.command('send-reply')
  .input(z.object({ ticketId: z.string(), reply: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['helpdesk', 'reply', input.ticketId, '--body', input.reply])
  .runner(local.runner('local'));

const approvalDecision = z.object({
  action: z.enum(['approve', 'revise', 'escalate']),
  reply: z.string().optional(),
  notes: z.string().optional(),
  auto: z.boolean().optional(),
});

const autoApproval: z.infer<typeof approvalDecision> = { action: 'approve', auto: true };

function isSafeCategory(metrics: Metrics, category: string): boolean {
  const record = metrics.rate(approvalByCategory, { group: category });
  return record.samples >= 200 && record.hits === record.samples;
}

const triageFlow = H.flow('triage')
  .input(conversationSchema)
  .step('classify', classifier, ctx => ({
    task: `Classify this conversation.\nSubject: ${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.message}`,
  }))
  .loop(
    'review',
    flow => flow
      .step('draft', drafter, ctx => ({
        task: `Draft a reply for a ${ctx.steps.classify.category} conversation.\nSummary: ${ctx.steps.classify.summary}\n\nCustomer wrote:\n${ctx.unit.attributes.message}`,
        skills: [ctx.steps.classify.category],
      }))
      .halt('approval', {
        ask: ctx => `Approve the reply to ticket ${ctx.unit.attributes.ticketId} (${ctx.steps.classify.category}):\n\n${ctx.steps.draft.reply}`,
        decision: approvalDecision,
        skip: ctx => isSafeCategory(ctx.metrics, ctx.steps.classify.category) ? autoApproval : undefined,
      }),
    { max: 3, until: ctx => ctx.steps.approval.action !== 'revise' },
  )
  .exit('escalated', ctx => ctx.steps.approval.action !== 'approve')
  .step('send', sendReply, ctx => ({
    ticketId: ctx.unit.attributes.ticketId,
    reply: ctx.steps.approval.reply ?? ctx.steps.draft.reply,
  }))
  .exit('sent');

const escalationFlow = H.flow('escalation')
  .input(escalationSchema)
  .halt('handle', {
    ask: ctx => `Escalated ticket ${ctx.unit.attributes.ticketId} "${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}": ${ctx.unit.attributes.reason}`,
    decision: z.object({ resolution: z.string() }),
  })
  .exit('resolved');

const slaHours: Record<ZendeskEvent['priority'], number> = { low: 72, normal: 24, high: 4, urgent: 1 };

function routeHelpdesk(event: ZendeskEvent, to: Router<ConversationAttrs, string>): Route {
  if (event.status === 'solved' || event.status === 'closed') {
    return to.signal(customerClosed, event.ticketId, {});
  }
  if (event.type === 'created') {
    return to.create({
      ticketId: event.ticketId,
      subject: event.subject,
      message: event.message,
      customerEmail: event.customerEmail,
      slaDueAt: new Date(event.createdAt.getTime() + slaHours[event.priority] * 3600000).toISOString(),
    });
  }
  if (event.type === 'replied') {
    return to.signal(customerReplied, event.ticketId, { message: event.message });
  }
  return to.skip();
}

const helpdeskToken = H.env('ZENDESK_TOKEN');

const conversations = H.lane('conversations', Conversation)
  .supply(zendesk.webhook({ port: H.slot.port(0), path: '/helpdesk', secret: H.env('ZENDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET') }), routeHelpdesk)
  .supply(zendesk.poll({ subdomain: 'acme', token: helpdeskToken, everyMinutes: 10 }), routeHelpdesk)
  .store(zendesk.store({ subdomain: 'acme', token: helpdeskToken }))
  .handler(triageFlow, {
    exits: { escalated: Escalated, sent: Sent },
    during: { classify: Classifying, draft: Drafting, approval: AwaitingApproval },
  })
  .on(customerReplied, {
    update: (attrs, payload) => ({ ...attrs, message: payload.message }),
    restart: 'classify',
  })
  .on(customerClosed, { enter: ClosedByCustomer })
  .on(slaBreached, { enter: SlaBreached })
  .ceiling({ maxUsd: 0.4, onExceed: 'halt' });

const escalations = H.lane('escalations', Escalation)
  .handler(escalationFlow, { exits: { resolved: Resolved }, during: { handle: Handling } });

const approvalByCategory: MetricRef<'rate'> = H.metric('approval-by-category', H.when.step(conversations, 'approval'))
  .samples(event => event.output === undefined || event.output.auto
    ? []
    : [{ group: event.outputs.classify?.category ?? 'unclassified', hit: event.output.action === 'approve' }]);

const approvalByModel: MetricRef<'rate'> = H.metric('approval-by-model', H.when.step(conversations, 'approval'))
  .samples(event => event.output === undefined || event.output.auto
    ? []
    : [{ group: event.models.draft ?? 'unknown', hit: event.output.action === 'approve' }]);

const taste = H.journal('support-taste', H.memory('taste', 'taste'))
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: 'memory/taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 12 })
  .readBy(drafterRole);

const experience = H.journal('support-experience', H.memory('experience', 'experience'))
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: 'memory/experience.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 8 })
  .readBy(drafterRole);

const slaBreach = H.trigger('sla-breach')
  .on(H.when.timer(conversations, { at: unit => new Date(unit.attributes.slaDueAt) }))
  .create(escalations, event => ({
    ticketId: event.unit.attributes.ticketId,
    subject: event.unit.attributes.subject,
    reason: `SLA breached at ${event.at.toISOString()} while ${event.unit.state}`,
  }))
  .signal(slaBreached, conversations, event => ({ key: event.unit.key, payload: {} }));

const reviewerNotesBecomeTaste = H.trigger('reviewer-notes-become-taste')
  .on(H.when.step(conversations, 'approval', { if: event => event.output?.notes !== undefined }))
  .record(taste, event => event.output?.notes
    ? { text: event.output.notes, status: 'candidate', when: { roles: [drafterRole] } }
    : undefined);

const scheduler = H.scheduler('time-to-breach')
  .priority(escalations, conversations)
  .rank(conversations, unit => Date.parse(unit.attributes.slaDueAt));

const reviewer = claudeCode.supervisor('reviewer', {
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.blockersResolve,
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.memoryWrite,
    H.ops.memoryCurate,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

export const harness = H.harness('support-triage')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.db' }))
  .lanes(conversations, escalations)
  .journals(taste, experience)
  .triggers(slaBreach, reviewerNotesBecomeTaste)
  .metrics(approvalByCategory, approvalByModel)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(reviewer)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: 'TELEMETRY.md' }));

void harness.start();

const haiku = anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });
const opus = anthropic.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });

const extractorRole = H.role('extractor')
  .intents('search', 'browse', 'read')

  .intents('read', 'record')
  .instructions('Write a sourced report. Every claim cites a URL from the extracted sources.');

const synthesizerModel = H.policy.model('synthesizer-model', [opus, sonnet], ctx => {
  const window = { lastDays: 30 };
  const opusRecord = ctx.metrics.rate(citationPass, { group: opus.name, window });
  const sonnetRecord = ctx.metrics.rate(citationPass, { group: sonnet.name, window });
  if (opusRecord.samples < 20 || sonnetRecord.samples < 20) {
    return opusRecord.samples <= sonnetRecord.samples ? opus : sonnet;
  }
  return opusRecord.rate >= sonnetRecord.rate ? opus : sonnet;

  .role(extractorRole)
  .model(haiku)
  .pool(apiPool)
  .output(z.object({

  .role(synthesizerRole)
  .model(synthesizerModel)
  .pool(apiPool)
  .output(z.object({
    report: z.string(),
    summary: z.string(),
    citations: z.array(z.string()),
  }));

  .input(z.object({ citations: z.array(z.string()) }))
  .argv(input => ['./bin/check-citations', ...input.citations])
  .runner(local.runner('local'));

  .input(topicSchema)
  .step('extract', extractor.batch(), ctx =>
    Array.from({ length: searchAngles }, (_unused, index) => ({
      task: `Research question: ${ctx.unit.attributes.question}\nCover angle ${index + 1} of ${searchAngles} on "${ctx.unit.attributes.title}", distinct from the other angles.`,
    })),
  )
  .exit('parked', ctx => ctx.steps.extract.reduce((count, result) => count + result.sources.length, 0) < 5)
  .step('synthesize', synthesizer, ctx => ({
    task: `Write a sourced report answering: ${ctx.unit.attributes.question}\n\nSources:\n${JSON.stringify(ctx.steps.extract.flatMap(result => result.sources))}`,

  .supply(H.operator)
  .supply(
    sqlite.scan('recurring-topics', {
      path: storePath,
      kind: 'Topic',
      schedule: H.clock('weekly-reopen').at('06:00', { on: 'mon' }),
    }),
    (stored, to) => {
      const parsed = topicSchema.safeParse(stored.attributes);
      return parsed.success && parsed.data.tags.includes('recurring') ? to.create(parsed.data) : to.skip();
    },
  )
  .store(sqlite.store({ path: storePath }))
  .handler(researchFlow, {
    exits: { parked: Parked, delivered: Delivered },
    during: { extract: Searching, synthesize: Synthesizing, 'cite-check': Checking },
  })
  .ceiling({ maxUsd: 3, onExceed: 'fail' });

const citationPass: MetricRef<'rate'> = H.metric('citation-pass', H.when.step(topics, 'cite-check'))
  .samples(event => [{ group: event.models.synthesize ?? 'unknown', hit: event.ok }]);

const dailySpend = H.metric('daily-spend', H.when.invocation({ lanes: [topics] }))
  .amounts(event => [{ group: 'research', amount: event.costUsd }]);

const deliveredCost = H.metric('delivered-topic-cost', H.when.transition(topics, { to: Delivered }))
  .amounts(event => [{ group: 'research', amount: event.unit.costUsd }]);

const findings = H.journal('report-findings', H.memory('finding', 'experience'))
  .store(pgvector.memoryStore({ url: H.env('PGVECTOR_URL'), table: 'findings', embeddingModel: 'text-embedding-3-small' }))
  .recall({ by: 'similarity', limit: 8 })
  .readBy(synthesizerRole);

const sourceExperience = H.journal('source-experience', H.memory('source-experience', 'experience'))
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: 'memory/sources.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 10 })
  .readBy(extractorRole, synthesizerRole)
  .recordedBy(synthesizerRole);

const checkedReportBecomesFinding = H.trigger('checked-report-becomes-finding')
  .on(H.when.step(topics, 'cite-check', { if: event => event.ok }))
  .record(findings, event => {
    const synthesis = event.outputs.synthesize;
    return synthesis === undefined
      ? undefined
      : {
          text: `When researching ${event.unit.attributes.title}, start from: ${synthesis.summary}, because a report with resolving citations established it`,
          when: { kinds: [Topic] },
        };
  });

const dailyBudgetUsd = 40;
const topicCeilingUsd = 3;

const scheduler = H.scheduler('daily-budget')
  .priority(topics)
  .admit(topics, ctx => {
    const spent = ctx.metrics.total(dailySpend, { window: { calendar: 'day' } });
    const delivered = ctx.metrics.total(deliveredCost, { window: { lastDays: 30 } });
    const projected = delivered.samples === 0 ? topicCeilingUsd : delivered.total / delivered.samples;
    return spent.total + projected <= dailyBudgetUsd;
  });

const supervisor = claudeCode.supervisor('supervisor', {
  grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.workCreate, H.ops.workCancel, H.ops.memoryRead, H.ops.telemetryRead],
});

export const harness = H.harness('research-pipeline')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.db' }))
  .lanes(topics)
  .journals(findings, sourceExperience)
  .triggers(checkedReportBecomesFinding)
  .metrics(citationPass, dailySpend, deliveredCost)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(supervisor)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: 'TELEMETRY.md' }));

void harness.start();

const Inspecting = H.state('Inspecting', 'active');

const StillValid = H.terminal('StillValid', 'success');
const Renewed = H.terminal('Renewed', 'success');

const Responding = H.state('Responding', 'active');
const Resolved = H.terminal('Resolved', 'success');
const Unresolved = H.terminal('Unresolved', 'failure');

const Incident = H.kind('Incident')

  .output(z.object({ daysLeft: z.number() }))
  .runner(input => hostRunner(input.host));

const renewCertificate = H.command('renew-certificate')
  .input(renewalSchema)
  .argv(input => ['/opt/ops/renew-cert.sh', input.domain])
  .runner(input => hostRunner(input.host));

const pageOnCall = H.command('page-on-call')
  .input(z.object({ title: z.string(), service: z.string() }))

  .input(z.object({ service: z.string(), responder: z.string() }))

const incidentFlow = H.flow('incident')

        decision: z.object({ resolved: z.boolean(), notes: z.string().optional() }),

  .exit('unresolved');

const services = ['api', 'web', 'worker'];
const databases = [

const operations = H.journal('operational-experience', H.memory('operational-experience', 'experience'))
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: 'memory/operations.jsonl' }))

const twoHoursMs = 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

const heartbeatStreakOpensIncident = H.trigger('heartbeat-streak-opens-incident')
  .on(H.when.pattern(heartbeats, { to: Down, consecutive: 3, per: unit => unit.attributes.service }))
  .create(incidents, event => ({

const failedBackupOpensIncident = H.trigger('failed-backup-opens-incident')

const slowBackupNote = H.trigger('slow-backup-note')

    when: { kinds: [Backup], resources: [event.unit.attributes.host] },

const scheduler = H.scheduler('ops')

const controlApi = http.controlApi('ops-control', {

  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(controlApi)

const apiAccount = anthropic.account('api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') });
const reviewers = H.pool('reviewers').accounts(apiAccount);

const firstIncumbent = anthropic.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });
const secondIncumbent = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const challenger = anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });

const comparisonWindow: Window = { lastDays: 90 };

function weakerIncumbent(metrics: Metrics): string | undefined {
  const first = metrics.rate(critiqueActedOn, { group: firstIncumbent.name, window: comparisonWindow });
  const second = metrics.rate(critiqueActedOn, { group: secondIncumbent.name, window: comparisonWindow });
  if (first.samples < 50 || second.samples < 50 || first.rate === second.rate) return undefined;
  return first.rate < second.rate ? firstIncumbent.name : secondIncumbent.name;
}

const firstSlot = H.policy.model(
  'first-reviewer-model',
  [firstIncumbent, challenger],
  (ctx): Model => (weakerIncumbent(ctx.metrics) === firstIncumbent.name ? challenger : firstIncumbent),
);

const secondSlot = H.policy.model(
  'second-reviewer-model',
  [secondIncumbent, challenger],
  (ctx): Model => (weakerIncumbent(ctx.metrics) === secondIncumbent.name ? challenger : secondIncumbent),
);

  points: z.array(z.string()),
});

const reviewerFirst = H.agent('reviewer-first').role(reviewer).model(firstSlot).pool(reviewers).output(critique);
const reviewerSecond = H.agent('reviewer-second').role(reviewer).model(secondSlot).pool(reviewers).output(critique);

const desk = local.runner('editorial-desk').slots(4);

const factFindings = z.object({
  issues: z.array(z.string()),
  repeatLesson: z.string().optional(),
});

const factCheck = H.command('fact-check')
  .input(z.object({ section: z.string(), body: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['fact-check', '--section', input.section, '--text', input.body])
  .output(factFindings)
  .runner(desk);

  .input(z.object({ first: critique, second: critique, facts: factFindings }))
  .argv(input => ['merge-critiques', '--json', JSON.stringify(input)])
  .output(z.object({ summary: z.string() }))
  .runner(desk);

const editorialDecision = z.object({
  action: z.enum(['accept', 'return']),
  notes: z.string(),
  scope: z.enum(['all', 'section']),
  actedOn: z.array(z.enum(['first', 'second'])),
});

const reviewFlow = H.flow('review-draft')
  .input(draftAttributes)
  .step('critiqueFirst', reviewerFirst, ctx => ({
    task: `Critique "${ctx.unit.attributes.title}":\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.body}`,
    resources: [`section/${ctx.unit.attributes.section}`],
  }))
  .step('critiqueSecond', reviewerSecond, ctx => ({
    task: `Critique "${ctx.unit.attributes.title}":\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.body}`,
    resources: [`section/${ctx.unit.attributes.section}`],
  }))
  .step('factCheck', factCheck, ctx => ({ section: ctx.unit.attributes.section, body: ctx.unit.attributes.body }))
  .step('merge', mergeCritiques, ctx => ({
    first: ctx.steps.critiqueFirst,
    second: ctx.steps.critiqueSecond,
    facts: ctx.steps.factCheck,
  }))
  .halt('editorial', {
    ask: ctx => `Accept or return "${ctx.unit.attributes.title}" (${ctx.unit.attributes.section}).\n\n${ctx.steps.merge.summary}`,
    decision: editorialDecision,
  })
  .exit('accepted', ctx => ctx.steps.editorial.action === 'accept')
  .exit('returned');

const cmsToken = H.env('CONTENTFUL_TOKEN');

const drafts = H.lane('drafts', Draft)
  .supply(contentful.drafts({ space: 'newsroom', token: cmsToken, everyMinutes: 10 }), (entry, to) =>
    to.create({ entryId: entry.id, title: entry.title, section: entry.section, body: entry.body }),
  )
  .store(contentful.store({ space: 'newsroom', token: cmsToken }))
  .handler(reviewFlow, {
    exits: { accepted: Accepted, returned: Returned },
    during: {
      critiqueFirst: InReview,
      critiqueSecond: InReview,
      factCheck: InReview,
      merge: InReview,
      editorial: WithEditor,
    },
  });

const critiqueActedOn: MetricRef<'rate'> = H.metric('critique-acted-on', H.when.step(drafts, 'editorial')).samples(
  event => {
    const decision = event.output;
    if (decision === undefined) return [];
    const samples: Sample[] = [];
    const firstModel = event.models.critiqueFirst;
    const secondModel = event.models.critiqueSecond;
    if (firstModel !== undefined) samples.push({ group: firstModel, hit: decision.actedOn.includes('first') });
    if (secondModel !== undefined) samples.push({ group: secondModel, hit: decision.actedOn.includes('second') });
    return samples;
  },
);

const editorNotesToTaste = H.trigger('editor-notes-to-taste')
  .on(H.when.step(drafts, 'editorial', { if: event => event.output?.action === 'return' }))
  .record(taste, event => {
    const decision = event.output;
    if (decision === undefined || decision.notes === '') return undefined;
    const section = event.unit.attributes.section;
    return {
      text: `When reviewing a draft, ${decision.notes}, because the editor returned "${event.unit.attributes.title}" for it.`,
      status: 'candidate',
      when: decision.scope === 'section' ? { kinds: [Draft], resources: [`section/${section}`] } : { kinds: [Draft] },
    };
  });

const repeatMistakeToExperience = H.trigger('repeat-mistake-to-experience')
  .on(H.when.step(drafts, 'factCheck', { if: event => event.output?.repeatLesson !== undefined }))
  .record(factLessons, event => {
    const lesson = event.output?.repeatLesson;
    return lesson === undefined ? undefined : { text: lesson, when: { kinds: [Draft], roles: [reviewer] } };
  });

const editorDesk = claudeCode.supervisor('editor-desk', {
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.blockersResolve,
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.memoryWrite,
    H.ops.memoryCurate,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

const content = H.harness('content-review')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(drafts)
  .journals(taste, factLessons)
  .triggers(editorNotesToTaste, repeatMistakeToExperience)
  .metrics(critiqueActedOn)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('content').priority(drafts))
  .clients(editorDesk)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: '.harness/board.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: '.harness/telemetry.md' }));

void content.start();

const Suspended = H.state('Suspended', 'waiting');
const Churned = H.terminal('Churned', 'neutral');

const Tenancy = H.kind('Tenancy')
  .attributes(tenancyAttributes)
  .states(DueForReview, Reviewing, Current, Suspended, Churned)
  .key(tenancy => tenancy.customerId)
  .initial(DueForReview);

const reviewDue = H.signal('review-due');
const suspend = H.signal('suspend');
const reinstate = H.signal('reinstate');
const churn = H.signal('churn');

const usageReport = H.command('usage-report')
  .input(z.object({ customerId: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['./billing/usage', input.customerId])
  .output(z.object({ seats: z.number(), monthlyUsd: z.number(), trend: z.string() }))
  .runner(box);

const accountManager = H.role('account-manager')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Summarise the month of usage in plain language and say whether an upsell is warranted.');

const summaryAgent = H.agent('tenancy-summary')
  .role(accountManager)
  .model(strong)
  .pool(pool)
  .output(z.object({ summary: z.string() }));

const tenancyReview = H.flow('tenancy-review')
  .input(tenancyAttributes)
  .step('usage', usageReport, ctx => ({ customerId: ctx.unit.attributes.customerId }))
  .step('summary', summaryAgent, ctx => ({
    task: `Customer ${ctx.unit.attributes.customerId} on ${ctx.unit.attributes.plan}: ${ctx.steps.usage.seats} seats, $${ctx.steps.usage.monthlyUsd}/month, trend ${ctx.steps.usage.trend}.`,

  .halt('upsell', {

  .exit('reviewed');

const billingEvents = webhook.json('billing-events', {
  port: H.slot.port(1),
  path: '/billing',
  secret: H.env('BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET'),
  payload: z.object({
    type: z.enum(['signup', 'suspended', 'reinstated', 'churned']),
    customerId: z.string(),
    plan: z.string(),
  }),
});

const tenancies = H.lane('tenancies', Tenancy)
  .supply(billingEvents, (event, to) => {
    if (event.type === 'signup') return to.create({ customerId: event.customerId, plan: event.plan });
    if (event.type === 'suspended') return to.signal(suspend, event.customerId, {});
    if (event.type === 'reinstated') return to.signal(reinstate, event.customerId, {});
    return to.signal(churn, event.customerId, {});
  })
  .supply(H.clock('monthly-review').at('09:00', { on: 1 }), (tick, to) =>
    to.signal(reviewDue, unit => unit.state === 'Current', {}),
  )
  .store(store)
  .handler(tenancyReview, {
    exits: { reviewed: Current },
    during: { usage: Reviewing, summary: Reviewing, upsell: Reviewing },
  })
  .on(reviewDue, { enter: DueForReview })
  .on(suspend, { enter: Suspended })
  .on(reinstate, { enter: Current })
  .on(churn, { enter: Churned });

const negotiationAttributes = z.object({
  vendor: z.string(),
  item: z.string(),
  targetPrice: z.number(),
  expiresAt: z.string(),
  round: z.number(),
  lastVendorMessage: z.string(),
});

const Drafting = H.state('Drafting', 'pending');
const Negotiating = H.state('Negotiating', 'active');
const AwaitingVendor = H.state('AwaitingVendor', 'waiting');
const Agreed = H.terminal('Agreed', 'success');
const WalkedAwayByUs = H.terminal('WalkedAwayByUs', 'neutral');
const WalkedAwayByThem = H.terminal('WalkedAwayByThem', 'neutral');
const Expired = H.terminal('Expired', 'neutral');

const Negotiation = H.kind('Negotiation')
  .attributes(negotiationAttributes)
  .states(Drafting, Negotiating, AwaitingVendor, Agreed, WalkedAwayByUs, WalkedAwayByThem, Expired)
  .key(negotiation => `${negotiation.vendor}/${negotiation.item}`)
  .initial(Drafting);

const vendorCountered = H.signal('vendor-countered').payload(z.object({ message: z.string() }));
const vendorAccepted = H.signal('vendor-accepted');
const vendorWalkedAway = H.signal('vendor-walked-away');
const expire = H.signal('expire');

const negotiator = H.role('negotiator')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Draft the next move in the procurement negotiation: a counter-offer, acceptance, or walking away.');

const negotiatorAgent = H.agent('negotiator')
  .role(negotiator)
  .model(strong)
  .pool(pool)
  .output(z.object({ move: z.enum(['offer', 'accept', 'walkAway']), message: z.string() }));

const sendToVendor = H.command('send-to-vendor')
  .input(z.object({ vendor: z.string(), message: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['./procurement/send', input.vendor, input.message])
  .runner(box);

const negotiationRound = H.flow('negotiation-round')
  .input(negotiationAttributes)
  .step('next', negotiatorAgent, ctx => ({
    task: `Round ${ctx.unit.attributes.round} with ${ctx.unit.attributes.vendor} for ${ctx.unit.attributes.item}, target $${ctx.unit.attributes.targetPrice}. Vendor said: ${ctx.unit.attributes.lastVendorMessage}`,
  }))
  .step('send', sendToVendor, ctx => ({ vendor: ctx.unit.attributes.vendor, message: ctx.steps.next.message }), {
    afterCrash: 'park',
  })
  .exit('agreed', ctx => ctx.steps.next.move === 'accept')
  .exit('walkedAway', ctx => ctx.steps.next.move === 'walkAway')
  .exit('offered');

const vendorReplies = webhook.json('vendor-replies', {
  port: H.slot.port(2),
  path: '/vendor',
  secret: H.env('VENDOR_WEBHOOK_SECRET'),
  payload: z.object({
    negotiation: z.string(),
    reply: z.enum(['counter', 'accept', 'walkAway']),
    message: z.string(),
  }),
});

const negotiations = H.lane('negotiations', Negotiation)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .supply(vendorReplies, (event, to) => {
    if (event.reply === 'counter') return to.signal(vendorCountered, event.negotiation, { message: event.message });
    if (event.reply === 'accept') return to.signal(vendorAccepted, event.negotiation, {});
    return to.signal(vendorWalkedAway, event.negotiation, {});
  })
  .store(store)
  .handler(negotiationRound, {
    exits: { agreed: Agreed, walkedAway: WalkedAwayByUs, offered: AwaitingVendor },
    during: { next: Negotiating, send: Negotiating },
  })
  .on(vendorCountered, {
    update: (attrs, payload) => ({ ...attrs, round: attrs.round + 1, lastVendorMessage: payload.message }),
    enter: Drafting,
  })
  .on(vendorAccepted, { enter: Agreed })
  .on(vendorWalkedAway, { enter: WalkedAwayByThem })
  .on(expire, { enter: Expired });

const negotiationExpiry = H.trigger('negotiation-expiry')
  .on(H.when.timer(negotiations, { at: unit => new Date(unit.attributes.expiresAt) }))
  .signal(expire, negotiations, event => ({ key: event.unit.key, payload: {} }));

const scheduler = H.scheduler('lifecycles')
  .priority(negotiations, tenancies, experiments)
  .admit(experiments, ctx => {
    const record = ctx.metrics.outcomes({ of: experiments, window: { lastDays: 180 } });
    if (record.terminal < 10) return true;
    const inconclusiveShare = record.byState.Inconclusive / record.terminal;
    return inconclusiveShare < 0.5 || ctx.active(experiments) === 0;
  });

const lifecycles = H.harness('lifecycles')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(experiments, tenancies, negotiations)
  .triggers(negotiationExpiry)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(
    claudeCode.supervisor('lifecycle-supervisor', {
      grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.workCreate, H.ops.workSignal, H.ops.workCancel, H.ops.blockersResolve, H.ops.telemetryRead],
    }),
  )
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: '.harness/board.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: '.harness/telemetry.md' }));

void lifecycles.start();

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H, MetricRef, Metrics, Model, Route, Router, Window } from 'harness-dsl';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { jsonl } from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { zendesk, ZendeskEvent } from 'harness-dsl/zendesk';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const conversationAttributes = z.object({
  ticketId: z.string(),
  subject: z.string(),
  message: z.string(),
  customerEmail: z.string(),
  slaDeadline: z.string(),
});

type ConversationAttributes = z.infer<typeof conversationAttributes>;

const New = H.state('New', 'pending');
const Classifying = H.state('Classifying', 'active');
const Drafting = H.state('Drafting', 'active');
const AwaitingApproval = H.state('AwaitingApproval', 'active');
const Sending = H.state('Sending', 'active');
const Sent = H.state('Sent', 'waiting');
const ClosedByCustomer = H.terminal('ClosedByCustomer', 'success');
const Escalated = H.terminal('Escalated', 'neutral');
const Breached = H.terminal('Breached', 'failure');

const Conversation = H.kind('Conversation')
  .attributes(conversationAttributes)
  .states(New, Classifying, Drafting, AwaitingApproval, Sending, Sent, ClosedByCustomer, Escalated, Breached)
  .key(conversation => conversation.ticketId)
  .initial(New);

const customerReplied = H.signal('customer-replied').payload(z.object({ message: z.string() }));
const customerFollowedUp = H.signal('customer-followed-up').payload(z.object({ message: z.string() }));
const customerClosed = H.signal('customer-closed');
const slaBreached = H.signal('sla-breached');
const extendSla = H.signal('extend-sla').payload(z.object({ slaDeadline: z.string() }));

const classifier = H.role('classifier').intents('read').instructions('Assign the conversation one support category.');
const drafter = H.role('drafter')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Draft the reply in the house tone. Follow recalled taste and experience.');

const apiAccount = anthropic.account('api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') });
const pool = H.pool('support').accounts(apiAccount);
const haiku = anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const opus = anthropic.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });

const month: Window = { calendar: 'month' };

const drafterModel = H.policy.model('drafter-model', [sonnet, opus], (ctx): Model => {
  const opened = ctx.metrics.total(auditsOpened, { window: month });
  const paused = ctx.metrics.paused({ lane: conversations, window: month });
  const sonnetApprovals = ctx.metrics.rate(approvalsByModel, { group: sonnet.name, window: { lastDays: 14 } });
  if (sonnetApprovals.samples >= 50 && sonnetApprovals.rate < 0.8) return opus;
  return opened.total >= 3 || paused.totalMs >= 3_600_000 ? opus : sonnet;
});

const classifierAgent = H.agent('classifier')
  .role(classifier)
  .model(haiku)
  .pool(pool)
  .output(z.object({ category: z.string() }));

const drafterAgent = H.agent('drafter')
  .role(drafter)
  .model(drafterModel)
  .pool(pool)
  .output(z.object({ reply: z.string() }));

const sendReply = H.command('send-reply')
  .input(z.object({ ticketId: z.string(), reply: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['helpdesk', 'reply', input.ticketId, '--body', input.reply])
  .runner(local.runner('support-box').slots(8));

function isSafeCategory(metrics: Metrics, category: string): boolean {
  const record = metrics.rate(approvals, { group: category });
  return record.hits >= 200 && record.hits === record.samples;
}

const approvalDecision = z.object({ action: z.enum(['approve', 'reject']), notes: z.string() });
const autoApproval: z.infer<typeof approvalDecision> = { action: 'approve', notes: '' };

const conversationFlow = H.flow('triage-conversation')
  .input(conversationAttributes)
  .step('classify', classifierAgent, ctx => ({
    task: `Classify this conversation.\nSubject: ${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.message}`,
  }))
  .loop(
    'drafting',
    round =>
      round
        .step('draft', drafterAgent, ctx => ({
          task: `Reply to ${ctx.unit.attributes.customerEmail}.\nSubject: ${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.message}`,
          skills: [ctx.steps.classify.category],
        }))
        .halt('approval', {
          ask: ctx => `Approve the reply to ticket ${ctx.unit.attributes.ticketId}:\n\n${ctx.steps.draft.reply}`,
          decision: approvalDecision,
          skip: ctx => (isSafeCategory(ctx.metrics, ctx.steps.classify.category) ? autoApproval : undefined),
        }),
    { max: 3, until: ctx => ctx.steps.approval.action === 'approve' },
  )
  .exit('escalated', ctx => ctx.steps.approval.action !== 'approve')
  .step('send', sendReply, ctx => ({ ticketId: ctx.unit.attributes.ticketId, reply: ctx.steps.draft.reply }), {
    afterCrash: 'park',
  })
  .exit('sent');

const slaHours: Readonly<Record<ZendeskEvent['priority'], number>> = { urgent: 1, high: 4, normal: 24, low: 48 };

function routeTicket(event: ZendeskEvent, to: Router<ConversationAttributes, string>): Route | readonly Route[] {
  if (event.status === 'solved' || event.status === 'closed') return to.signal(customerClosed, event.ticketId, {});
  if (event.type === 'created') {
    return to.create({
      ticketId: event.ticketId,
      subject: event.subject,
      message: event.message,
      customerEmail: event.customerEmail,
      slaDeadline: new Date(event.createdAt.getTime() + slaHours[event.priority] * 3_600_000).toISOString(),
    });
  }
  if (event.type === 'replied') {
    return [
      to.signal(customerReplied, unit => unit.key === event.ticketId && unit.state !== 'Sent', { message: event.message }),
      to.signal(customerFollowedUp, unit => unit.key === event.ticketId && unit.state === 'Sent', {
        message: event.message,
      }),
    ];
  }
  return to.skip();
}

const helpdeskToken = H.env('ZENDESK_TOKEN');

const conversations = H.lane('conversations', Conversation)
  .supply(zendesk.webhook({ port: H.slot.port(1), path: '/zendesk', secret: H.env('ZENDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET') }), routeTicket)
  .supply(zendesk.poll({ subdomain: 'acme', token: helpdeskToken, everyMinutes: 15 }), routeTicket)
  .store(zendesk.store({ subdomain: 'acme', token: helpdeskToken }))
  .handler(conversationFlow, {
    exits: { escalated: Escalated, sent: Sent },
    during: { classify: Classifying, draft: Drafting, approval: AwaitingApproval, send: Sending },
  })
  .on(customerReplied, { update: (attrs, payload) => ({ ...attrs, message: payload.message }), restart: 'classify' })
  .on(customerFollowedUp, { update: (attrs, payload) => ({ ...attrs, message: payload.message }), enter: New })
  .on(customerClosed, { enter: ClosedByCustomer })
  .on(slaBreached, { enter: Breached })
  .on(extendSla, { update: (attrs, payload) => ({ ...attrs, slaDeadline: payload.slaDeadline }) })
  .ceiling({ maxUsd: 0.4, onExceed: 'halt' });

const escalationAttributes = z.object({ conversation: z.string(), reason: z.string() });

const EscalationOpen = H.state('EscalationOpen', 'pending');
const EscalationHandling = H.state('EscalationHandling', 'active');
const EscalationResolved = H.terminal('EscalationResolved', 'success');

const Escalation = H.kind('Escalation')
  .attributes(escalationAttributes)
  .states(EscalationOpen, EscalationHandling, EscalationResolved)
  .key(escalation => escalation.conversation)
  .initial(EscalationOpen);

const escalationFlow = H.flow('handle-escalation')
  .input(escalationAttributes)
  .halt('handle', {
    ask: ctx => `Escalated conversation ${ctx.unit.attributes.conversation}: ${ctx.unit.attributes.reason}`,
    decision: z.object({ resolution: z.string() }),
  })
  .exit('resolved');

const escalations = H.lane('escalations', Escalation)
  .handler(escalationFlow, { exits: { resolved: EscalationResolved }, during: { handle: EscalationHandling } });

const auditAttributes = z.object({ category: z.string(), rateAtOpen: z.number() });

const AuditOpen = H.state('AuditOpen', 'pending');
const AuditReview = H.state('AuditReview', 'active');
const AuditClosed = H.terminal('AuditClosed', 'success');
const AuditCancelled = H.terminal('AuditCancelled', 'neutral');

const Audit = H.kind('Audit')
  .attributes(auditAttributes)
  .states(AuditOpen, AuditReview, AuditClosed, AuditCancelled)
  .key(audit => audit.category)
  .initial(AuditOpen)
  .onCancelled(AuditCancelled);

const auditFlow = H.flow('audit-category')
  .input(auditAttributes)
  .halt('review', {
    ask: ctx => `Approvals for ${ctx.unit.attributes.category} fell to ${ctx.unit.attributes.rateAtOpen.toFixed(2)}. Review recent drafts.`,
    decision: z.object({ findings: z.string() }),
  })
  .exit('closed');

const audits = H.lane('audits', Audit)
  .handler(auditFlow, { exits: { closed: AuditClosed }, during: { review: AuditReview } });

const approvals: MetricRef<'rate'> = H.metric('approval-rate', H.when.step(conversations, 'approval')).samples(event => {
  const category = event.outputs.classify?.category;
  const decision = event.output;
  return category === undefined || decision === undefined ? [] : [{ group: category, hit: decision.action === 'approve' }];
});

const approvalsByModel: MetricRef<'rate'> = H.metric('approval-rate-by-model', H.when.step(conversations, 'approval')).samples(
  event => {
    const model = event.models.draft;
    const decision = event.output;
    return model === undefined || decision === undefined ? [] : [{ group: model, hit: decision.action === 'approve' }];
  },
);

const modelErrors: MetricRef<'rate'> = H.metric('model-error-rate', H.when.invocation({ lanes: [conversations] })).samples(
  event => (event.model === undefined ? [] : [{ group: 'conversations', hit: !event.ok }]),
);

const auditsOpened: MetricRef<'total'> = H.metric('audits-opened', H.when.transition(audits, { to: AuditOpen })).amounts(
  event => [{ group: event.unit.attributes.category, amount: 1 }],
);

const tasteKind = H.memory('reply-taste', 'taste');
const experienceKind = H.memory('drafting-experience', 'experience');

const taste = H.journal('taste', tasteKind)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 12 })
  .readBy(drafter);

const experience = H.journal('experience', experienceKind)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/experience.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 12 })
  .readBy(drafter);

const slaBreach = H.trigger('sla-breach')
  .on(
    H.when.timer(conversations, {
      at: unit => (unit.position === 'terminal' || unit.state === 'Sent' ? undefined : new Date(unit.attributes.slaDeadline)),
    }),
  )
  .signal(slaBreached, conversations, event => ({ key: event.unit.key, payload: {} }))
  .create(escalations, event => ({
    conversation: event.unit.key,
    reason: `SLA deadline ${event.unit.attributes.slaDeadline} passed.`,
  }));

const unapprovedEscalates = H.trigger('unapproved-escalates')
  .on(H.when.transition(conversations, { to: Escalated }))
  .create(escalations, event => ({ conversation: event.unit.key, reason: 'No draft was approved after three rounds.' }));

const approvalDropOpensAudit = H.trigger('approval-drop-opens-audit')
  .on(
    H.when.crossing(approvals, {
      window: { lastDays: 7 },
      minSamples: 50,
      enter: { below: 0.9 },
      exit: { above: 0.95 },
    }),
  )
  .create(audits, event => (event.edge === 'entered' ? { category: event.group, rateAtOpen: event.value } : undefined))
  .record(experience, event =>
    event.edge === 'entered'
      ? {
          text: `When drafting for ${event.group}, recall the stricter phrasing, because approvals fell to ${event.value.toFixed(2)} over ${event.samples} samples.`,
          status: 'candidate',
          when: { roles: [drafter], skills: [event.group] },
        }
      : undefined,
  )
  .signal(H.cancel, audits, event =>
    event.edge === 'exited'
      ? { key: event.group, payload: { reason: `Approval rate recovered to ${event.value.toFixed(2)}.` } }
      : undefined,
  );

const modelErrorsPauseLane = H.trigger('model-errors-pause-lane')
  .on(
    H.when.crossing(modelErrors, {
      window: { lastHours: 1 },
      minSamples: 20,
      enter: { above: 0.2 },
      exit: { below: 0.05 },
    }),
  )
  .pause(conversations, event =>
    event.edge === 'entered'
      ? `Model error rate ${event.value.toFixed(3)} over ${event.samples} invocations in the last hour.`
      : undefined,
  )
  .resume(conversations, event =>
    event.edge === 'exited'
      ? `Model error rate recovered to ${event.value.toFixed(3)} over ${event.samples} invocations.`
      : undefined,
  );

const reviewerDesk = claudeCode.supervisor('reviewer-desk', {
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.workSignal,
    H.ops.blockersResolve,
    H.ops.lanesPause,
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.memoryWrite,
    H.ops.memoryCurate,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

const support = H.harness('support-self-watch')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(conversations, escalations, audits)
  .journals(taste, experience)
  .triggers(slaBreach, unapprovedEscalates, approvalDropOpensAudit, modelErrorsPauseLane)
  .metrics(approvals, approvalsByModel, modelErrors, auditsOpened)
  .scheduler(
    H.scheduler('support')
      .priority(escalations, conversations, audits)
      .rank(conversations, unit => new Date(unit.attributes.slaDeadline).getTime()),
  )
  .clients(reviewerDesk)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: '.harness/board.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: '.harness/telemetry.md' }));

void support.start();

  .states(SmokeQueued, SmokeTesting, SmokePassed, SmokeBroken)
  .key(smoke => `${smoke.version}/${smoke.platform}`)
  .initial(SmokeQueued);

const smokeTest = H.command('smoke-test')
  .input(smokeAttributes)
  .argv(input => ['./scripts/smoke', '--version', input.version, '--platform', input.platform])
  .acceptExitCodes(0, 1)
  .runner(releaseBox);

const smokeFlow = H.flow('smoke')
  .input(smokeAttributes)
  .step('test', smokeTest, ctx => ({ version: ctx.unit.attributes.version, platform: ctx.unit.attributes.platform }), {
    afterCrash: 'rerun',
  })
  .exit('passed', ctx => ctx.steps.test.exitCode === 0)
  .exit('broken');

const smoke = H.lane('smoke', Smoke)
  .handler(smokeFlow, { exits: { passed: SmokePassed, broken: SmokeBroken }, during: { test: SmokeTesting } });

const build = H.command('build')
  .input(z.object({ commit: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['make', 'release', `COMMIT=${input.commit}`])
  .runner(releaseBox);

const announcementInput = z.object({ channel: z.string(), version: z.string() });

const announce = H.command('announce')
  .input(announcementInput)
  .argv(input => ['./scripts/announce', '--channel', input.channel, '--version', input.version])
  .runner(releaseBox);

const announcementPosted = H.command('announcement-posted')
  .input(announcementInput)
  .argv(input => ['./scripts/announce', '--check', '--channel', input.channel, '--version', input.version])
  .output(z.boolean())
  .runner(releaseBox);

const reviewer = H.role('release-reviewer')
  .intents('read', 'search')
  .instructions('Review the release build output and changes. Say ship or hold, with reasons.');

const writer = H.role('changelog-writer')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Write the public release summary.');

const subscription = claudeCode.subscription('release-max', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_RELEASE_TOKEN') });
const apiAccount = anthropic.account('release-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') });

const reviewerAgent = H.agent('release-reviewer')
  .role(reviewer)
  .model(claudeCode.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' }))
  .pool(H.pool('release-subscription').accounts(subscription))
  .output(z.object({ verdict: z.enum(['ship', 'hold']), notes: z.string() }));

const summarizer = H.agent('release-summarizer')
  .role(writer)
  .model(anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' }))
  .pool(H.pool('release-api').accounts(apiAccount))
  .output(z.object({ summary: z.string() }));

const releaseFlow = H.flow('release')
  .input(releaseAttributes)
  .step('build', build, ctx => ({ commit: ctx.unit.attributes.commit }), { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .step('announce', announce, ctx => ({ channel: ctx.unit.attributes.channel, version: ctx.unit.attributes.version }), {
    afterCrash: 'park',
    alreadyDone: announcementPosted,
  })
  .step(
    'review',
    reviewerAgent,
    ctx => ({
      task: `Review release ${ctx.unit.attributes.version} at ${ctx.unit.attributes.commit}.\n\nBuild output:\n${ctx.steps.build.stdout}`,
    }),
    { afterCrash: 'askDriver' },
  )
  .halt('approval', {
    ask: ctx => `Approve release ${ctx.unit.attributes.version}? Reviewer says ${ctx.steps.review.verdict}: ${ctx.steps.review.notes}`,
    decision: z.object({ approve: z.boolean(), note: z.string() }),
  })
  .exit('rejected', ctx => !ctx.steps.approval.approve)
  .step('summarize', summarizer.batch(), ctx => [
    {
      task: `Summarize release ${ctx.unit.attributes.version} for the changelog. Review notes: ${ctx.steps.review.notes}`,
    },
  ])
  .spawn('smoke', smoke, ctx =>
    ctx.unit.attributes.platforms.map(platform => ({ version: ctx.unit.attributes.version, platform })),
  )
  .exit('released', ctx => ctx.steps.smoke.every(child => child.verdict === 'success'))
  .exit('smokeFailed');

const releases = H.lane('releases', Release)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .store(sqlite.store({ path: '.harness/releases.sqlite' }))
  .handler(releaseFlow, {
    exits: { rejected: Rejected, released: Released, smokeFailed: SmokeFailed },
    during: {
      build: Building,
      announce: Announcing,
      review: Reviewing,
      approval: AwaitingApproval,
      summarize: Summarizing,
      smoke: Smoking,
    },
  });

const releaseManager = claudeCode.supervisor('release-manager', {
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.workCreate,
    H.ops.workCancel,
    H.ops.blockersResolve,
    H.ops.attemptsRecover,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

const release = H.harness('release')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(releases, smoke)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('release').priority(releases, smoke))
  .clients(releaseManager)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: '.harness/board.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: '.harness/telemetry.md' }));

void release.start();

=== END ===
