import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import * as sqlite from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import * as anthropic from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import * as claudeCode from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import * as http from 'harness-dsl/http';
import * as markdown from 'harness-dsl/markdown';
import * as local from 'harness-dsl/local';

const shell = local.shell({ slots: 4 });
const apiAccount = anthropic.account('operations-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') });
const writerModel = anthropic.model('claude-sonnet-4-5');

const SampleDue = H.state('SampleDue', 'pending');
const Sampling = H.state('Sampling', 'active');
const Observing = H.state('Observing', 'waiting');
const AWins = H.state('AWins', 'terminal', 'success');
const BWins = H.state('BWins', 'terminal', 'success');
const Inconclusive = H.state('Inconclusive', 'terminal', 'neutral');

const Experiment = H.work('Experiment')
  .attributes({ experimentId: z.string(), metric: z.string() })
  .states([SampleDue, Sampling, Observing, AWins, BWins, Inconclusive])
  .timers(() => ({ hourly: H.time.every({ hours: 1 }) }))
  .key(u => u.attributes.experimentId);

const measure = H.command('measure-experiment', ['scripts/measure-experiment.sh']).parses({
  elapsedHours: z.number(),
  aRate: z.number(),
  bRate: z.number(),
  pValue: z.number(),
});

function conclude(sample: { elapsedHours: number; aRate: number; bRate: number; pValue: number }): 'observing' | 'aWins' | 'bWins' | 'inconclusive' {
  if (sample.elapsedHours < 14 * 24) return 'observing';
  if (sample.pValue >= 0.05) return 'inconclusive';
  return sample.aRate > sample.bRate ? 'aWins' : 'bWins';
}

const sampleExperiment = H.flow('sample-experiment')
  .requires({ experimentId: z.string(), metric: z.string() })
  .step('sample', measure, c => ({ args: [c.input.experimentId, c.input.metric, String(c.unit.createdAt)] }), { restart: 'rerun' })
  .ends(['observing', 'aWins', 'bWins', 'inconclusive'], c => conclude(c.out.sample.data));

const experiments = H.lane('experiments', Experiment)
  .supply([H.supply.operator()])
  .runner(shell)
  .handler(sampleExperiment, {
    states: { observing: Observing, aWins: AWins, bWins: BWins, inconclusive: Inconclusive },
    opens: Sampling,
  })
  .reacts({ hourly: H.reaction(SampleDue).from([Observing]) });

const Customer = H.state('Customer', 'waiting');
const ReviewDue = H.state('ReviewDue', 'pending');
const Reviewing = H.state('Reviewing', 'active');
const Suspended = H.state('Suspended', 'waiting');
const Churned = H.state('Churned', 'terminal', 'neutral');

const Tenancy = H.work('Tenancy')
  .attributes({ customerId: z.string(), plan: z.string() })
  .states([Customer, ReviewDue, Reviewing, Suspended, Churned])
  .events({ suspended: {}, reinstated: {}, churned: {} })
  .timers(() => ({ monthlyReview: H.time.monthly(1, '09:00', 'Europe/London') }))
  .key(u => u.attributes.customerId);

const usage = H.command('tenancy-usage', ['scripts/tenancy-usage.sh']).parses({
  seats: z.number(),
  spendUsd: z.number(),
  trend: z.string(),
});

const accountReviewer = H.role('account-reviewer')
  .intents(['read'])
  .input({ customerId: z.string(), plan: z.string(), seats: z.number(), spendUsd: z.number(), trend: z.string() })
  .output({ summary: z.string(), upsellCase: z.string() });
const tenancySummarizer = H.agent('tenancy-summarizer', accountReviewer).model(writerModel).pool(apiAccount);

const upsell = H.decision('upsell', { upsell: z.boolean(), note: z.string() });

const reviewTenancy = H.flow('review-tenancy')
  .requires({ customerId: z.string(), plan: z.string() })
  .step('usage', usage, c => ({ args: [c.input.customerId] }), { restart: 'rerun' })
  .step('summary', tenancySummarizer, c => ({
    customerId: c.input.customerId,
    plan: c.input.plan,
    seats: c.out.usage.data.seats,
    spendUsd: c.out.usage.data.spendUsd,
    trend: c.out.usage.data.trend,
  }))
  .halt('upsell', upsell, { ask: c => `${c.input.customerId} on ${c.input.plan}\n${c.out.summary.summary}\nCase: ${c.out.summary.upsellCase}\nUpsell?` })
  .ends(['reviewed'], () => 'reviewed');

const billingEvent = z.object({
  customerId: z.string(),
  plan: z.string(),
  type: z.enum(['signed', 'suspended', 'reinstated', 'churned']),
});

const tenancies = H.lane('tenancies', Tenancy)
  .supply([
    H.supply.operator(),
    http.webhook(Tenancy, { path: '/billing', port: H.slot.port(1), secret: H.env('BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET'), body: billingEvent }, (body, supply) =>
      body.type === 'signed'
        ? supply.create({ attributes: { customerId: body.customerId, plan: body.plan } })
        : supply.event(body.customerId, body.type, {})),
  ])
  .runner(shell)
  .handler(reviewTenancy, { states: { reviewed: Customer }, opens: Reviewing })
  .reacts({
    monthlyReview: H.reaction(ReviewDue).from([Customer]),
    suspended: H.reaction(Suspended).from([Customer, ReviewDue, Reviewing]).cancels(),
    reinstated: H.reaction(Customer).from([Suspended]),
    churned: H.reaction(Churned).from([Customer, ReviewDue, Reviewing, Suspended]).cancels(),
  });

const RoundDue = H.state('RoundDue', 'pending');
const Drafting = H.state('Drafting', 'active');
const AwaitingVendor = H.state('AwaitingVendor', 'waiting');
const Agreed = H.state('Agreed', 'terminal', 'success');
const WalkedAway = H.state('WalkedAway', 'terminal', 'neutral');
const VendorWalkedAway = H.state('VendorWalkedAway', 'terminal', 'failure');
const Expired = H.state('Expired', 'terminal', 'failure');

const Negotiation = H.work('Negotiation')
  .attributes({ negotiationId: z.string(), vendor: z.string(), item: z.string(), targetUsd: z.number(), expiresAt: z.number() })
  .states([RoundDue, Drafting, AwaitingVendor, Agreed, WalkedAway, VendorWalkedAway, Expired])
  .events({
    vendorReplied: { amountUsd: z.number(), message: z.string() },
    vendorAccepted: { amountUsd: z.number() },
    vendorWalkedAway: { reason: z.string() },
  })
  .timers(t => ({ expires: t.attribute('expiresAt') }))
  .key(u => u.attributes.negotiationId);

const negotiatorRole = H.role('negotiator')
  .intents(['read'])
  .input({ vendor: z.string(), item: z.string(), targetUsd: z.number(), round: z.number(), replies: z.array(z.string()) })
  .output({ action: z.enum(['offer', 'walkAway']), amountUsd: z.number(), message: z.string() });
const negotiator = H.agent('negotiator', negotiatorRole).model(writerModel).pool(apiAccount);

const sendOffer = H.command('send-offer', ['scripts/send-offer.sh']);

const negotiationRound = H.flow('negotiation-round')
  .requires({ negotiationId: z.string(), vendor: z.string(), item: z.string(), targetUsd: z.number() })
  .events({ vendorReplied: { amountUsd: z.number(), message: z.string() } })
  .step('offer', negotiator, c => ({
    vendor: c.input.vendor,
    item: c.input.item,
    targetUsd: c.input.targetUsd,
    round: c.attempt.number,
    replies: c.events.vendorReplied.map(reply => `${reply.payload.amountUsd} USD: ${reply.payload.message}`),
  }))
  .exit('walkedAway', c => c.out.offer.action === 'walkAway')
  .step('send', sendOffer, c => ({ args: [c.input.negotiationId, String(c.out.offer.amountUsd)], stdin: c.out.offer.message }), { restart: 'escalate' })
  .ends(['awaitingVendor'], () => 'awaitingVendor');

const vendorMessage = z.object({
  negotiationId: z.string(),
  type: z.enum(['offer', 'accept', 'walkaway']),
  amountUsd: z.number(),
  message: z.string(),
});

const negotiations = H.lane('negotiations', Negotiation)
  .supply([
    H.supply.operator(),
    http.webhook(Negotiation, { path: '/vendor', port: H.slot.port(1), secret: H.env('VENDOR_WEBHOOK_SECRET'), body: vendorMessage }, (body, supply) =>
      body.type === 'offer'
        ? supply.event(body.negotiationId, 'vendorReplied', { amountUsd: body.amountUsd, message: body.message })
        : body.type === 'accept'
          ? supply.event(body.negotiationId, 'vendorAccepted', { amountUsd: body.amountUsd })
          : supply.event(body.negotiationId, 'vendorWalkedAway', { reason: body.message })),
  ])
  .runner(shell)
  .handler(negotiationRound, { states: { walkedAway: WalkedAway, awaitingVendor: AwaitingVendor }, opens: Drafting })
  .reacts({
    vendorReplied: H.reaction(RoundDue).from([AwaitingVendor]),
    vendorAccepted: H.reaction(Agreed).from([AwaitingVendor, RoundDue, Drafting]).cancels(),
    vendorWalkedAway: H.reaction(VendorWalkedAway).from([AwaitingVendor, RoundDue, Drafting]).cancels(),
    expires: H.reaction(Expired).from([AwaitingVendor, RoundDue, Drafting]).cancels(),
  });

const schedule = H.policy.schedule('rounds-reviews-then-experiments', c => {
  const inconclusive = c.metrics.outcomes({ kind: Experiment, window: { days: 180 } }).share(Inconclusive);
  const experimentsLast = inconclusive.n >= 10 && inconclusive.rate !== null && inconclusive.rate > 0.5;
  return {
    start: c.order(
      x => (x.is(negotiations) ? 0 : x.is(tenancies) ? 1 : experimentsLast ? 3 : 2),
      x => x.enqueuedAt,
    ),
  };
});

const desk = H.access('commercial-desk').allows([
  H.ops.readWork,
  H.ops.createWork,
  H.ops.sendEvents,
  H.ops.resolveBlocks,
  H.ops.manageAttempts,
  H.ops.readTelemetry,
]);

export const lifecycles = H.harness('lifecycles')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger('.harness/ledger.sqlite'))
  .lanes([experiments, tenancies, negotiations])
  .schedule(schedule)
  .clients([claudeCode.supervisor('commercial-supervisor', desk, { port: H.slot.port(0) })])
  .projections([markdown.board('BOARD.md'), markdown.telemetry('TELEMETRY.md')]);

    subject: c.input.subject,
    messages: [c.input.message, ...c.events.customerReplied.map(e => e.payload.message)],
  }))
  .mark('awaitingApproval')
  .halt('approval', approval, { ask: c => `Category ${c.input.category}. Approve this reply?\n\n${c.out.draft.reply}` })
  .exit('rejected', c => c.out.approval.approved === false)
  .step('send', reply, c => ({
    ticketId: c.input.ticketId,
    body: c.out.approval.edited.length > 0 ? c.out.approval.edited : c.out.draft.reply,
  }))
  .ends(['sent'], () => 'sent');

const conversationOf = (ticket: ZendeskTicket) => ({
  attributes: { ticketId: ticket.id, category: 'unclassified', slaDueAt: ticket.slaDueAt ?? ticket.updatedAt + 4 * 3600000 },
  fields: { subject: ticket.subject, message: ticket.latestComment, requester: ticket.requesterEmail },
});

const conversations = H.lane('conversations', Conversation)
  .supply([
    zendesk.webhook(Conversation, { ...helpdesk, port: H.slot.port(1), signingSecret: H.env('ZENDESK_SIGNING_SECRET') }, (event, supply) => {
      if (event.type === 'ticket.created') return supply.create(conversationOf(event.ticket));
      if (event.type === 'ticket.solved') return supply.event(String(event.ticket.id), 'solved', {});
      return event.fromCustomer ? supply.event(String(event.ticket.id), 'customerReplied', { message: event.ticket.latestComment }) : null;
    }),
    zendesk.poll(Conversation, H.time.every({ minutes: 5 }), helpdesk, (ticket, supply) => supply.create(conversationOf(ticket))),
  ])
  .store(zendesk.store(Conversation, {
    ...helpdesk,
    status: { New: 'new', Classifying: 'open', Drafting: 'open', AwaitingApproval: 'pending', Sent: 'solved', ClosedByCustomer: 'closed', Escalated: 'hold' },
  }))
  .budget({ maxUsdPerUnit: 0.4, onExceed: 'halt' })
  .handler(handleConversation, {
    states: { drafting: Drafting, awaitingApproval: AwaitingApproval, rejected: New, sent: Sent },
    opens: Classifying,
  })
  .reacts({
    customerReplied: H.reaction(New).from([Classifying, Drafting, AwaitingApproval]).cancels(),
    solved: H.reaction(ClosedByCustomer).from([New, Classifying, Drafting, AwaitingApproval]).cancels(),
    slaBreached: H.reaction(Escalated).from([New, Classifying, Drafting, AwaitingApproval]).cancels(),
  });

const auditFindings = H.decision('audit-findings', { findings: z.string(), actions: z.array(z.string()) });

const auditCategory = H.flow('audit-category')
  .requires({ category: z.string(), rate: z.number() })
  .halt('findings', auditFindings, { ask: c => `Approvals for ${c.input.category} fell to ${c.input.rate.toFixed(2)}. Record findings.` })
  .ends(['concluded'], () => 'concluded');

const audits = H.lane('audits', Audit)
  .handler(auditCategory, { states: { concluded: Concluded }, opens: Auditing })
  .reacts({ recovered: H.reaction(Withdrawn).from([Open, Auditing]).cancels() });

const approvalRate = H.metric('approval-rate').of(approval).hit(d => d.approved);
const approvalFloor = H.threshold('approval-floor', approvalRate, {
  window: { days: 7 },
  minSamples: 50,
  trips: { below: 0.9 },
  resets: { above: 0.95 },
  kind: Conversation,
  per: 'category',
});

const modelErrors = H.metric('model-error-rate').invocations(['agent']).hit(i => i.status === 'failed' || i.status === 'timedOut');
const errorCeiling = H.threshold('model-error-ceiling', modelErrors, {
  window: { hours: 1 },
  minSamples: 20,
  trips: { above: 0.2 },
  resets: { below: 0.05 },
});

const opensAudit = H.trigger('open-category-audit', H.on.crossed(approvalFloor))
  .creates(e => audits.unit({ attributes: { category: e.group.category, trippedAt: e.trippedAt, rate: e.rate } }))
  .records(draftingExperience, e => [{
    rule: `When drafting for ${e.group.category}, recall the stricter phrasing`,
    because: `approvals fell to ${e.rate.toFixed(2)} over ${e.n} samples`,
    when: { roles: [drafterRole], attributes: { category: e.group.category } },
  }]);

const withdrawsAudit = H.trigger('withdraw-category-audit', H.on.recovered(approvalFloor))
  .sends(e => audits.event(`${e.group.category}@${e.trippedAt}`, 'recovered', { rate: e.rate }));

const pausesConversations = H.trigger('pause-on-model-errors', H.on.crossed(errorCeiling)).pauses(conversations);
const resumesConversations = H.trigger('resume-after-model-errors', H.on.recovered(errorCeiling)).resumes(conversations);

const schedule = H.policy.schedule('audits-then-time-to-breach', c => {
  const monthStart = c.clock.startOfMonth();
  const auditsThisMonth = (category: string) => c.metrics.count({ kind: Audit, where: { category }, sinceMs: monthStart });
  return {
    start: c.order(
      x => (x.is(audits) ? 0 : 1),
      x => (x.is(conversations) ? x.unit.attributes.slaDueAt - c.clock.now : 0),
      x => (x.is(conversations) ? -auditsThisMonth(x.unit.attributes.category) : 0),
      x => x.enqueuedAt,
    ),
  };
});

const reviewerAccess = H.access('reviewer').allows([
  H.ops.readWork,
  H.ops.updateWork,
  H.ops.sendEvents,
  H.ops.resolveBlocks,
  H.ops.readMemory,
  H.ops.writeMemory,
  H.ops.curateMemory,
  H.ops.readTelemetry,
]);

export const support = H.harness('support')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger('.harness/ledger.sqlite'))
  .lanes([conversations, audits])
  .triggers([opensAudit, withdrawsAudit, pausesConversations, resumesConversations])
  .schedule(schedule)
  .clients([claudeCode.supervisor('support-supervisor', reviewerAccess, { port: H.slot.port(0) })])
  .projections([markdown.board('BOARD.md'), markdown.telemetry('TELEMETRY.md')]);

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import * as sqlite from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import * as anthropic from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import * as claudeCode from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import * as slack from 'harness-dsl/slack';
import * as markdown from 'harness-dsl/markdown';
import * as local from 'harness-dsl/local';

const shell = local.shell({ slots: 4, cwd: 'release' });
const platforms: readonly string[] = ['linux', 'macos', 'windows'];

const SmokeQueued = H.state('SmokeQueued', 'pending');
const SmokeTesting = H.state('SmokeTesting', 'active');
const SmokePassed = H.state('SmokePassed', 'terminal', 'success');
const SmokeBroken = H.state('SmokeBroken', 'terminal', 'failure');

const Smoke = H.work('Smoke')
  .attributes({ version: z.string(), platform: z.string() })
  .states([SmokeQueued, SmokeTesting, SmokePassed, SmokeBroken])
  .key(u => `${u.attributes.version}/${u.attributes.platform}`);

const smokeTest = H.command('smoke-test', ['scripts/smoke-test.sh']).parses({ passed: z.boolean() });

const runSmoke = H.flow('run-smoke')
  .requires({ version: z.string(), platform: z.string() })
  .step('test', smokeTest, c => ({ args: [c.input.version, c.input.platform] }), { restart: 'rerun' })
  .exit('broken', c => c.out.test.data.passed === false)
  .ends(['passed'], () => 'passed');

const smoke = H.lane('smoke', Smoke)
  .runner(shell)
  .retry(H.retry.fixed({ maxRetries: 2, delayMs: 30000 }))
  .handler(runSmoke, { states: { broken: SmokeBroken, passed: SmokePassed }, opens: SmokeTesting });

const Requested = H.state('Requested', 'pending');
const Building = H.state('Building', 'active');
const Approving = H.state('Approving', 'active');
const Smoking = H.state('Smoking', 'active');
const Released = H.state('Released', 'terminal', 'success');
const SmokeFailed = H.state('SmokeFailed', 'terminal', 'failure');
const Rejected = H.state('Rejected', 'terminal', 'neutral');

const Release = H.work('Release')
  .attributes({ version: z.string() })
  .states([Requested, Building, Approving, Smoking, Released, SmokeFailed, Rejected])
  .key(u => u.attributes.version);

const build = H.command('build', ['scripts/build.sh']);
const announce = slack.notify('release-announcement', { webhookUrl: H.env('SLACK_RELEASES_WEBHOOK') });
const announcementPosted = H.command('announcement-posted', ['scripts/announcement-posted.sh']).parses({ done: z.boolean() });

const releaseReviewer = H.role('release-reviewer')
  .intents(['read'])
  .input({ version: z.string(), buildLog: z.string() })
  .output({ notes: z.string(), concerns: z.array(z.string()) });
const reviewer = H.agent('release-review', releaseReviewer)
  .model(claudeCode.model('claude-opus-4-1'))
  .pool(claudeCode.subscription('release-max', { configDir: H.env('CLAUDE_RELEASE_DIR') }));

const releaseWriter = H.role('release-writer')
  .input({ version: z.string(), review: z.string() })
  .output({ summary: z.string() });
const summarizer = H.agent('release-summary', releaseWriter)
  .model(anthropic.model('claude-haiku-4-5', { batch: true }))
  .pool(anthropic.account('release-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') }));

const releaseApproval = H.decision('release-approval', { ship: z.boolean(), note: z.string() });

const shipRelease = H.flow('ship-release')
  .requires({ version: z.string() })
  .step('build', build, c => ({ args: [c.input.version] }), { restart: 'rerun' })
  .step('announce', announce, c => ({ text: `Release ${c.input.version} is built and entering review.` }), { restart: { probe: announcementPosted } })
  .step('review', reviewer, c => ({ version: c.input.version, buildLog: c.out.build.stdout }), { restart: 'ask' })
  .mark('approving')
  .halt('approval', releaseApproval, {
    ask: c => `Ship ${c.input.version}?\n\n${c.out.review.notes}\n\nConcerns: ${c.out.review.concerns.join('; ')}`,
  })
  .exit('rejected', c => c.out.approval.ship === false)
  .batch('summarize', summarizer, c => [{ version: c.input.version, review: c.out.review.notes }])
  .mark('smoking')
  .spawn('smoke', {
    outlet: 'smoke',
    child: { version: z.string(), platform: z.string() },
    items: c => platforms.map(platform => ({ version: c.input.version, platform })),
  })
  .ends(['released', 'smokeFailed'], c => (c.out.smoke.every(child => child.verdict === 'success') ? 'released' : 'smokeFailed'));

const releases = H.lane('releases', Release)
  .supply([H.supply.operator()])
  .runner(shell)
  .wip(1)
  .retry(H.retry.fixed({ maxRetries: 1, delayMs: 60000 }))
  .handler(shipRelease, {
    states: { approving: Approving, smoking: Smoking, rejected: Rejected, released: Released, smokeFailed: SmokeFailed },
    opens: Building,
    spawns: { smoke: child => smoke.unit({ attributes: { version: child.version, platform: child.platform } }) },
  });

const releaseManager = H.access('release-manager').allows([
  H.ops.readWork,
  H.ops.createWork,
  H.ops.resolveBlocks,
  H.ops.manageAttempts,
  H.ops.readTelemetry,
]);

export const releaseHarness = H.harness('release')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger('.harness/ledger.sqlite'))
  .lanes([releases, smoke])
  .schedule(H.policy.schedule('releases-then-smoke', c => ({
    start: c.order(x => (x.is(releases) ? 0 : 1), x => x.enqueuedAt),
  })))
  .clients([claudeCode.supervisor('release-supervisor', releaseManager, { port: H.slot.port(0) })])
  .projections([markdown.board('BOARD.md'), markdown.telemetry('TELEMETRY.md')]);

export const node = releaseHarness.start();
